title: cobweb to 9 string
description: A simple utility to convert Cobwebs into String and back again using a 1:9 ratio.
body: Have you ever found yourself with an abundance of cobwebs and no string, or vice versa? This lightweight data pack adds two logical, shapeless crafting recipes to bridge that gap. It maintains a balanced 1:9 ratio, ensuring consistency with other block-to-item conversions in Minecraft (like Iron Blocks to Ingots).
